$schema_note: Art-style spec for the game's title banner. Feed 'prompt_template' (with {TITLE} replaced) to an image generator, or use the structured fields to rebuild the prompt in your own words. Values sampled from the original src/assets/title.png.
era_influence: 90s golden-age Sega / arcade cabinet marquee art
classic JRPG title screens (Final Fantasy, Golden Axe)
AAA fantasy game logos (ornate metal-and-gem crests)
medium: digital painting imitating embossed cast metal on carved stone

composition.layout: single line of text centered on a rectangular plaque, ornamental frame around it, jewel finials centered on the top and bottom edges
composition.background: transparent or near-black; the plaque IS the artwork
composition.margins: frame flourishes may slightly overhang the plaque corners

typography.case: small caps (large initial capitals on each word, smaller capitals for the rest)
typography.letterform: classical Roman serif, wide proportions, sharp thin serifs
typography.treatment: thick beveled 3D faces like cast gold bullion
typography.bevel: hard center ridge down each stroke; top-lit so upper facets glow and lower facets fall to deep bronze
typography.outline: fine dark brown keyline around every letter to lift it off the plaque
typography.avoid: modern sans-serifs, flat vector fills, chrome or silver lettering

plaque.material: near-black cracked stone / aged dark iron
plaque.texture: subtle fissures and chips catching faint warm light
plaque.finish: matte, so the gold reads bright against it

frame.style: slim double-rule gold border tracing the plaque edge
frame.corners: ornate gold scroll flourishes / bracket filigree at all four corners
frame.corner_gems: small round emeralds set into the corner fittings
frame.finials: faceted sapphire diamond mounted in gold at top-center and bottom-center of the frame

effects: specular star glints on letter ridges and gem facets
soft warm bloom hugging the gold, no wide glow
deep occlusion where letters meet the plaque

rendering.detail: crisp, high micro-contrast; readable when scaled to 20% size
rendering.texture_on_gold: faint hammered / worn patina, not mirror-clean
rendering.edges: clean silhouette, no painterly spill outside the plaque

negative_prompt: drop shadows floating on empty space
prompt_template: Ornate fantasy game logo, the words '{TITLE}' in beveled cast-gold small-caps Roman serif lettering, top-lit with bright facets fading to deep bronze, fine dark keyline around each letter, mounted on a wide near-black cracked stone plaque, slim double gold border frame with ornate scroll filigree corners, small round emeralds in the corner fittings, a faceted sapphire diamond in a gold mount centered on the top and bottom edges, single warm torchlight from above, specular glints on letter ridges and gems, subtle worn patina on the gold, 90s golden-age arcade marquee and classic JRPG title-screen style, crisp high-detail digital painting, wide 7:1 banner, dark background
usage_notes: Shorter titles read better: 1-3 words, roughly 8-16 characters total fills the plaque like the original.
Ask the generator for a transparent or plain-black background so the banner drops onto the game's backdrop.
Deliver at 1512x220 or any ~7:1 size; the game scales it down (crisp micro-contrast matters more than resolution).
The in-game icon/coin art is separate; only the banner needs to match this spec.
